data.summary:
Results-driven Business Analyst and Product Owner with over 9 years of experience 
Extensive Business Analysis & Domain Expertise in digital onboarding, KYC, authentication systems, and risk/security frameworks. Proven ability to gather, analyze, and translate complex business requirements into actionable technical solutions aligned with regulatory and business goals. Strong Product Ownership & Agile Delivery Experience in multiple platforms simultaneously. Skilled in backlog prioritization, sprint planning, user story creation, and leading Agile ceremonies to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery. Expert in leveraging SQL, Power BI, and data analysis techniques to derive actionable insights. Successfully implemented automation and RPA solutions (UiPath) that reduced manual effort and improved operational efficiency. Proven ability to manage and collaborate with stakeholders across business, technology, security, and operations teams. Strong communication skills to align diverse teams, resolve conflicts, and drive consensus for successful project outcomes. Comprehensive experience across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirement gathering, documentation (BRD/FSD), UAT coordination, testing, and deployment. Proven track record of reducing defects and improving delivery timelines significantly.

projects.description:
Offensive security assessments (Red Teaming) Managed offensive security assessments for ~300 applications (web, mobile, tablet banking). Performed S3 bucket and document- store review processes, CI/CD pipeline security checks, vulnerability assessments (VA/Compliance reviews), and risk revalidation. Prioritized findings, coordinated remediation with engineering and security teams, and produced VAPT reports and executive risk summaries.
BEAT-Edge / Intel Pulse / BEATFlow BEATFlow is a workflow and project management platform developed by Acuity Knowledge Partners. It’s designed for workflow automation, task tracking, collaboration, and knowledge management within organizations — especially in financial services like investment banks, consulting firms, and asset managers.
Digital Onboarding - Yes Bank, RBL Bank & HDFC Bank This portal will manage the creation and management of onboarding requests, including Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures and digital e-sign processes

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Aug’25 – Present | Emirates NBD Bank, Dubai | Business Analyst
Security Requirements & Risk Analysis: Gathered security requirements, conducted risk assessments, and translated insights into actionable remediation roadmaps in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders. Attack Surface Management (ASM): Managed ASM programs to identify external exposure, prioritize high-risk assets, and minimize the organization’s attack surface. Vulnerability Assessment & Remediation: Performed security risk assessments and converted technical vulnerabilities into clear, business-focused remediation requirements. Red & Blue Team Coordination: Coordinated red team and blue team exercises, translating outcomes into prioritized remediation plans and continuous improvement strategies. Performance Improvement & Stakeholder Management: Achieved a 30% reduction in defects and a 25% improvement in delivery timelines while effectively managing over 100 stakeholders.
Oct’24 – Jul’25 | Acuity Knowledge Partners, Bengaluru | Senior Business Analyst
Product Ownership & Business Analysis: Managed business analysis and product ownership for four internal platforms (Intel Pulse, Agent Fleet, Beat- flow, RFPPulse), including requirement definition, backlog prioritization, user story creation, acceptance criteria, and release coordination. Process Optimization & RPA Implementation: Gathered requirements, mapped business processes, and implemented UiPath RPA solutions, reducing reporting time by 40%. Agile Delivery Management: Owned Agile delivery using JIRA and Confluence, managing sprint planning, backlog grooming, stakeholder communication, and UAT to ensure timely deployments. SDLC Lifecycle Management: Led end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) activities from requirement gathering to deployment. Requirements Visualization: Created detailed use cases and wireframes to effectively visualize and communicate business requirements.
Mar’21 – Sep’24 | Khosla Labs | Business Analyst
Requirement Gathering & Product Roadmap: Led business requirement gathering and defined product roadmaps for Aadhaar-based authentication and eKYC solutions for AUA/KUA licensed entities, prioritizing features based on regulatory and market needs. Solution Development & API Services: Designed and delivered solutions including Aadhaar Vault, Tokenization, Masking Verification APIs, and DocExtract to enable secure data storage, retrieval, and automated identity verification workflows. Documentation & Process Mapping: Developed process maps, Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), and use cases while collaborating closely with Engineering and Design teams during grooming and sprint planning. Agile Execution & Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitated Scrum ceremonies, managed product backlogs, and aligned cross-functional stakeholders across Technology, Security, Sales, and Marketing to ensure on-time releases, product adoption, and successful UAT. Data Validation & Reporting: Executed SQL queries for data validation and generated reports to support system accuracy and performance. Data Analysis & Decision Support: Conducted in-depth data analysis to provide actionable insights and support strategic business decision-making.
Mar’20 – Mar’21 Replicon Software Pvt. Ltd, Bengaluru | | Quality Analyst
Test Strategy & Quality Assurance: Implemented comprehensive test strategies, including functional, integration, and regression testing, to ensure software reliability and compliance with requirements. Test Planning & Execution: Developed and maintained test plans, test cases, and automation scripts, executing both manual and automated testing to validate system performance and functionality. Defect Management & Collaboration: Reported and tracked defects using JIRA, collaborating closely with development teams to prioritize fixes and enhance overall release quality.
Mar’19 – Feb’20 | Gloify Software Pvt. Ltd, Bengaluru | Quality Analyst
Application Testing & Quality Assurance: Executed comprehensive testing for mobile and web applications, including functional, UI, and cross-device testing, while documenting issues with clear reproduction steps to expedite resolution. Test Case Management & Regression Testing: Created and maintained test cases and actively participated in regression testing to ensure stability and support timely product releases.
Mar’15 – Aug’17 | WM Logistics Pv.t Ltd, Indore | Process Associate
Test Case Development & Coverage: Developed and implemented test cases to ensure comprehensive coverage across smoke, functional, integration, and system testing.
